meaning: Conditional rental-project underwriting diagnostic; no legal/physical feasibility, financing award or investor-return finding.

methods.capital: Sum rounded explicit cost lines; zero costs require attributed input assumptions.
methods.debt: Minimum of declared DSCR, LTC, LTV and absolute capacities plus scenario funding need after declared sources; monthly fixed-rate amortization.
methods.gap: Uses minus modeled primary debt and declared other sources; proposed is not committed and gap is not a subsidy award.
methods.income: Each annual income stream grows from year-one dollars; start/end years gate receipt, loss applies by stream.
methods.noi: Effective income less operating expenses; replacement reserve treatment for coverage is explicit.
